zh: 各位置互不影响：每个位置要么保持 min(a, b)，要么在被选中后变成 min(a, 2b)。
把每个位置被选中的增益 min(a, 2b) − min(a, b) 算出来（可能为负或 0），基准分加上最大的至多 k 个正增益即可。
先累加基准分 Σmin(a[i], b[i])；求出每个增益并从大到小排序，取前 k 个中的正数加上去。2b 可达 2×10⁹、总和可达 2×10¹⁴，全程用 64 位整数。
en: Positions are independent: each one either keeps min(a, b) or, if chosen, becomes min(a, 2b).
Compute each position's gain from being chosen, min(a, 2b) − min(a, b) (which may be negative or zero); the answer is the base score plus the largest at most k positive gains.

First sum the base score Σmin(a[i], b[i]); compute every gain, sort them in descending order, and add the positive ones among the first k. 2b reaches 2×10⁹ and the total 2×10¹⁴, so use 64-bit integers throughout.

explanationEn:
## Approach

The gain from operating on a position is min(aᵢ, 2bᵢ) − min(aᵢ, bᵢ). Add the largest at most k positive gains to the base score.

## Correctness

A plan's score equals the base score plus the sum of the chosen gains. Positions do not interact, so taking the largest sum of positive gains among at most k positions is globally optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
